# Read the CSV file
df <- read_csv("RawData/measles_summary.csv")

# View the data

str(df)

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
### ---------------------------
### Meta-analysis of ratios
### ---------------------------

# Adult (>=18) cases for each outbreak
A <- c(163, 122, 247, 18, 53)   # Ohio, NYC, Texas, Kansas, New Mexico

# Child (5–17) cases
C <- c(151, 148, 286, 35, 23)

# Names of outbreaks
outbreaks <- c("Ohio 2014", "NYC 2019", "Texas 2025",
               "Kansas 2025", "New Mexico 2025")

# Compute ratios
R <- A / C

# Log ratios
y <- log(R)

# Standard error of log-ratio: sqrt( 1/A + 1/C )
SE <- sqrt(1/A + 1/C)

# Variances
v <- SE^2

# Inverse-variance weights
w <- 1 / v

# Fixed-effects pooled log-ratio
mu_hat <- sum(w * y) / sum(w)

# Standard error of pooled estimate
SE_mu <- sqrt(1 / sum(w))

# 95% confidence interval
lower <- mu_hat - 1.96 * SE_mu
upper <- mu_hat + 1.96 * SE_mu

# Back-transform to ratio scale
R_pooled <- exp(mu_hat)
CI_lower <- exp(lower)
CI_upper <- exp(upper)

### ---------------------------
### Print results
### ---------------------------

cat("Meta-analysis of Adult/Child Ratios\n")
cat("----------------------------------------\n")
cat("Pooled Ratio: ", round(R_pooled, 3), "\n")
cat("95% CI:      ", round(CI_lower, 3), "–", round(CI_upper, 3), "\n\n")

# Show each outbreak ratio
results <- data.frame(
  Outbreak = outbreaks,
  Adults = A,
  Children_5_17 = C,
  Ratio = round(R, 3),
  Log_Ratio = round(y, 3),
  SE_Log_Ratio = round(SE, 3)
)

print(results)

### ---------------------------
### Optional: Forest plot
### ---------------------------

library(ggplot2)

df_plot <- data.frame(
  Outbreak = outbreaks,
  Ratio = R,
  Lower = exp(y - 1.96 * SE),
  Upper = exp(y + 1.96 * SE)
)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Outbreak, y = Ratio)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = R_pooled, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Meta-analysis of Adult/Child Ratios",
       y = "Ratio (Adults / Children 5–17)",
       x = "")

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
